Synopsis:
Russia's Foreign Ministry issued its strongest-yet warning to the UK, threatening to strike British military assets inside and outside Ukraine in retaliation for Ukrainian use of British Storm Shadow cruise missiles on Russian territory. The escalation follows London's decision to share classified technology enabling Ukraine to domestically produce Storm Shadows. France has also approved technology licensing for the same missile system. Russia frames British involvement as legally complicit in "terrorism," warning of catastrophic consequences and conflict escalation to a new level.
